fields.description:
Add the self-contained rebar MCP HTTP service to the box per the ADR (deft-evolutive-mosasaur):
a new `mcp` compose service + `Dockerfile.mcp` running loopback-bound `rebar-mcp` HTTP, and an
nginx `/mcp/` TLS-edge location with a **switchable upstream** so the autodeploy slice
(panicky-sylphish-foxterrier) can flip traffic blue→green atomically. INFRA only; the live AWS
provision/deploy is approval-gated (a human performs it). Single concern: the on-box MCP service
and its edge — autodeploy logic lives in foxterrier, secrets in avians.

## Scope
- `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`: an `mcp` service (image built from `Dockerfile.mcp`),
  loopback-published on a new dedicated port, `restart: always`, with a container `healthcheck`
  hitting the MCP `/health` endpoint. `MCP_PATHS` for the autodeploy change-detector are declared
  here so foxterrier can consume them.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp`: builds `rebar-mcp` from the same `src/rebar` source the review-bot
  builds from (shared base layer). Boots with `transport=http`, `http_tls_at_edge=true`, allowed
  hosts/origins and `auth_resource_server_url` from config, `static` verifier — the ADR-decided
  fail-closed HTTP posture (ADR 0050 guards: DNS-rebinding/Origin, non-loopback-bind ack).
- `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template`: a new `location /mcp/` proxying to the MCP loopback port via a
  named `upstream` block whose target is a materialized include (the atomic-flip seam), consistent
  with the existing `/review/` and header-guarded `/opcert/` patterns. TLS terminates at nginx.
- A `/health` endpoint on the MCP server exposing an integer `in_flight` gauge that counts ONLY
  long-running/certified ops (review_plan/verify_completion/review_code/scan_spec), plus a bounded
  SIGTERM grace window so a retiring container lets an in-flight op finish before exit. The gauge
  feeds foxterrier's retire check; it does not gate the deploy.

## Approach + rationale
Mirror the proven opcert edge (loopback service + nginx location) but expose a switchable upstream
rather than a hardcoded `proxy_pass host:port`, because the ADR's blue-green cutover needs to
re-point the upstream atomically (the local updater's `current`-pointer analog). `/health` counts
only expensive ops so retirement waits on billable work, not trivial reads. Shared base image keeps
disk/build cost low; the extra retained MCP images are bounded by the existing docker prune.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tier: **real CLI/compose integration** (per test-design §3, "CLI/streams" + "producer/consumer"):
  `docker compose up mcp` in a local/staging compose brings the service up healthy; the container
  `healthcheck` passes against `/health`, and `/health` returns a JSON body with an integer
  `in_flight` field. Oracle: `in_flight` reads 0 at idle and increments during a simulated
  long-running op (a stubbed certified tool) and returns to 0 after — asserted via the real
  endpoint, with a trivial read op NOT moving the gauge (contrast case, §6).
- [ ] Fail-closed boot: with a non-loopback bind and NO TLS-at-edge/allowlist ack, the server refuses to
  boot (assert exit non-zero + the ADR-0050 guard message); with the ack + `static` verifier and a
  valid bearer it serves, and an absent/invalid bearer is rejected 401 through the nginx `/mcp/`
  edge (oracle: HTTP status from a real request through the rendered nginx config).
- [ ] The nginx `/mcp/` upstream is a named block sourced from a materialized include (the flip seam
  foxterrier re-points), verified by `nginx -t` on the rendered template.
- [ ] SIGTERM grace: sending SIGTERM while a long op is in flight lets it finish within the grace window
  before the process exits (subprocess/signal test, §7), not an immediate kill.

## Compat / rollback
Purely additive — new service, new port, new nginx location; touches no existing service. Rollback =
remove the `mcp` service/location (gerrit/review-bot/opcert unaffected). Security trust-boundary:
new authenticated network endpoint — enforced by `static` bearer at the app + TLS at the nginx edge.

Depends on: deft-evolutive-mosasaur (ADR). Blocks: panicky-sylphish-foxterrier (needs the
switchable upstream + `/health`), unmythical-uninspired-olm (needs a reachable endpoint).
